# Load coastal shapefile and define projection

```{r, ROMS.test}

# Since the data falls within two UTM zones and there is not an ideal projection to use, apply a custom equal area Albers projection
aea_custom <- "+proj=aea +lat_1=30 +lat_2=50 +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-124.5 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

# High res coastal boundary from NOAA
land.barrier <- read_sf(here(dir, "Data", "Shapefiles",
                             "land.barrier.shp"))

```

# Create plot gradicule labels

Note this is only for graph labels and is chosen based on the mean lat and lon values of the haul transect locations.

```{r, Create.plot.label.breaks}

lat_breaks <- seq(27, 55, 4)  # Latitude breaks

lat_labels <- c(paste(27, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(31, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(35, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(39, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(43, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(47, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(51, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""),
                paste(55, "\u00b0", "N", sep=""))

```

# Create base map

Note that cropping should be done before projecting the data and projecting the data should be done before any intersection analysis.

```{r, basemap}


# 1. Turn off s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Make coastline backdrop
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PacificCoast <- ne_countries(scale = 10, returnclass = "sf") 
PacificCoast3.wgs84 <- st_crop(PacificCoast, xmin = -133, xmax = -110, 
                               ymin = 25, 
                         ymax = 55)
class(PacificCoast3.wgs84)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot output
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = PacificCoast3.wgs84, fill = "#D2B48C", col = "#927143") +
    xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") +
    ggtitle("West Coast map") +
    theme_classic()

```

```{r, adjust.map.dimensions}
xmin

xmax

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

PacificCoast.wgs84.map
```

# Creat hline boundaries

Because the current model looks at only the Northern sub population in US waters, one of the boundary extents should include the national boarders. The second should look at the coast of California where the most mixing is thought to occur for Pacific Sardine sub populations (under the current survey hypothesis). From the data we are looking at data from UTM zone 10 and UTM zone 11 use the USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic project (ESRI:102003). The corresponding ESPG code for ESRI:102003 is aea_custom.

```{r, find.original.model.break.dimensions}

# 1. Turn off s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# First transform the data to be able to do intersection analysis
PacificCoast.aea_custom <- st_transform(PacificCoast.wgs84, crs = aea_custom)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# In order to find the state boundary extents, use ne_states function in 
# rnaturalearth
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Find state boundaries
PCoastStates.wgs84 <- ne_states(returnclass = "sf")

PCoastStates.aea_custom <-
  # transform to NAD83 / Conus Albers
  st_transform(PCoastStates.wgs84, crs = aea_custom) 

PCoastStates <- st_intersection(PCoastStates.aea_custom, PacificCoast.aea_custom) %>%
  st_transform(., crs = 4326)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For EEZ definitions 
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# https://nauticalcharts.noaa.gov/data/us-maritime-limits-and-boundaries.html

eez.dir <- here(dir, "Data", "Shapefiles", "EEZ.Boundaries")
eez <- read_sf(paste(eez.dir, "/USMaritimeLimitsNBoundaries.shp", sep = ""))

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Putting it all together
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

hlines <- eez %>%
  filter(REGION == "Pacific Coast") %>%
  mutate(
    # Create southern US EEZ boundary
    ymin = st_bbox(.)["ymin"],
    # Create northern US EEZ boundary
    ymax = st_bbox(.)["ymax"],
    # Create northern stock boundary (Westernmost Point, CA)
    nstock = 40.4385,
    # Create southern stock boundary (Point Conception, CA)
    point.concept = 34.4486)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a transformed line for residual plots
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create northern stock boundary (Westernmost Point, CA)
nstock <- st_sf(
  geometry = 
    st_sfc(
      st_linestring(matrix(c(-133, 40.4385, -111, 40.4385), 
                           ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))),
  crs = 4326
  ) %>%
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)

# Create southern stock boundary (Point Conception, CA)
point.concept <- st_sf(
  geometry = 
    st_sfc(
      st_linestring(matrix(c(-133, 34.4486, -111, 34.4486), 
                           ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))),
  crs = 4326
  ) %>%
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)
  
# Isolate extent of EEZ for USA  
hlines_aea.custom <- eez %>%
  filter(REGION == "Pacific Coast") %>%
  # Transform to aea
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create southern US EEZ boundary
    ymin = st_bbox(.)["ymin"],
    # Create northern US EEZ boundary
    ymax = st_bbox(.)["ymax"]
    )

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = nstock, col = "blue", 
             linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf(data = point.concept, col = "red", 
             linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_hline(data = hlines_aea.custom, aes(yintercept = ymin), col = "black", 
             linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(data = hlines_aea.custom, aes(yintercept = ymax), col = "black", 
             linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = PacificCoast.aea_custom) +
  # Remove added space on x-axis
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

```

# Create city markers

To make the map easier to interpret, add the names and locations of most populated cites

```{r, add.map.details}

# 1. Turn off s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# populated areas (cities and city names)
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Populated10.wgs84 <- ne_download(scale = 110, type = "populated_places_simple", 
                           category = "cultural", 
                           returnclass = "sf") 

Populated10.aea_custom <- Populated10.wgs84 %>%
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)

Populated10 <- st_intersection(Populated10.aea_custom, PacificCoast.aea_custom) %>%
  st_transform(., crs = 4326)

```

# Create area definitions

Note that the min and max of the plot should have great spatial bound across all data sets and that this will likely change in the next iteration.

```{r, define.OM.box.extents}

# 1. Turn on s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define data boundaries
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

xmin = -134.11630 # CUFES boundary
ymin =  28.5      # Artificial boundary
xmax = -114.0     # Artificial boundary
ymax = 54.74310   # CUFES boundary

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For Northern US EEZ to Inf
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

z1.bbox_coords <- c(xmin, unique(hlines$ymax), xmax, ymax)
names(z1.bbox_coords) = c("xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax")

z1bbp.wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(z1.bbox_coords)) 
st_crs(z1bbp.wgs84) = 4326

st_bbox(z1bbp.wgs84)

# Convert to m for intersection
z1bbp <- st_sf(Area_id = 1,
               geometry = z1bbp.wgs84) %>%
  st_transform(.,crs = aea_custom)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For Northern stock to Northern US EEZ
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

z2.bbox_coords <- c(xmin, unique(hlines$nstock), xmax, unique(hlines$ymax))
names(z2.bbox_coords) = c("xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax")

z2bbp.wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(z2.bbox_coords)) 
st_crs(z2bbp.wgs84) = 4326

st_bbox(z2bbp.wgs84)

# Convert to m for intersection
z2bbp <- st_sf(Area_id = 2,
               geometry = z2bbp.wgs84) %>%
  st_transform(.,crs = aea_custom)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For Southern stock to Northern stock
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

z3.bbox_coords <- c(xmin, unique(hlines$point.concept), xmax,
                    unique(hlines$nstock))
names(z3.bbox_coords) = c("xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax")

z3bbp.wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(z3.bbox_coords))
st_crs(z3bbp.wgs84) = 4326

st_bbox(z3bbp.wgs84)

# Convert to m for intersection
z3bbp <- st_sf(Area_id = 3,
               geometry = z3bbp.wgs84) %>%
  st_transform(.,crs = aea_custom)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For Southern US EEZ to Southern stock
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

z4.bbox_coords <- c(xmin, unique(hlines$ymin), xmax,
                    unique(hlines$point.concept))
names(z4.bbox_coords) = c("xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax")

z4bbp.wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(z4.bbox_coords))
st_crs(z4bbp.wgs84) = 4326

st_bbox(z4bbp.wgs84)

# Convert to m for intersection
z4bbp <- st_sf(Area_id = 4,
               geometry = z4bbp.wgs84) %>%
  st_transform(.,crs = aea_custom)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For Inf to Southern US EEZ
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

z5.bbox_coords <- c(xmin, ymin, xmax, unique(hlines$ymin))
names(z5.bbox_coords) = c("xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax")

z5bbp.wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(z5.bbox_coords))
st_crs(z5bbp.wgs84) = 4326

st_bbox(z5bbp.wgs84)

# Convert to m for intersection
z5bbp <- st_sf(Area_id = 5,
               geometry = z5bbp.wgs84) %>%
  st_transform(.,crs = aea_custom)

```

# Prepare survey data structure

```{r, adapt.survey.structure}

# 1. Turn on s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

TwoSeas.dat2 <- fread(
  here(dir, "Data", "Canada.and.CPS.ATM.Survey.Data.w.latBin.csv"))
# View(TwoSeas.dat2)

# Check how many keys are present in 
# the ROMS hindcast
test.keys <- TwoSeas.dat2 %>% 
  filter(Year < 2021) 
length(unique(test.keys$keys))
# [1] 3249

# Create transect data
## Rename columns to match function 
survey.transects.sf <- TwoSeas.dat2 %>%
  group_by(keys) %>% 
  # remove potentially conflicting column names
  select(-c(X,Y)) %>%
  mutate(FID = keys) %>%
  make_transect_sf(., crs = 4326) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Project the data to Albers Conical Equal Area
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom) %>%
  group_by(Year, Season, latBin, keys, YearSeas.nm) %>%
  mutate(Haul.kg = round(sum(Scaled_Biomass_Contribution), 7),
            Haul.check = first(Species_weight),
            Fin_sweep.m3 = first(Fin_sweep.m3)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Year, Season, latBin, keys, YearSeas.nm, len.bin) %>%
  mutate(Haul_Bin.kg = round(sum(Scaled_Biomass_Contribution), 7)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Month = month(date)) %>%
  mutate(survey_date = as.Date(paste0(Year, "-", Month, "-01"))) %>%
  ungroup()

z1bbp.aea.tr <- z1bbp.wgs84 %>% st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)
z2bbp.aea.tr <- z2bbp.wgs84 %>% st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)
z3bbp.aea.tr <- z3bbp.wgs84 %>% st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)
z4bbp.aea.tr <- z4bbp.wgs84 %>% st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)
z5bbp.aea.tr <- z5bbp.wgs84 %>% st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)

```

# CDO regridding of MLD test (2-step)

```{r, test.mld.def}

# 1. Turn on s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

# File path
nc_file.mld <- here(dir, "Data", "ROMS2", "Regridded", "WGS-84",
                    "allvars_mld_hindcast_2020_mld_masked_regrid.nc")

# Input ROMS files
fls <- list.files(here(dir, "Data", "ROMS2", "Regridded", "WGS-84"), 
                  pattern = "^allvars_mld_hindcast_.*\\.nc$", 
                  full.names = TRUE)

# Open the NetCDF file
nc.mld <- nc_open(nc_file.mld)

# Get all variable names
var_names <- names(nc.mld$var)
var_names
# [1] "mld"

st.mld <- read_stars(nc_file.mld)

# 2. Force the CRS assignment (this populates the NULL CRS)
st.mld <- st_set_crs(st.mld, 4326)

# Check if meta data is conserved
attributes(st.mld)$units

# Often meta data will not be conserved and you will need to manually assign it
attr(st.mld[[1]], "units") <- nc.mld$var$mld$units

# Check that it is saved
attr(st.mld[[1]], "units")

# Assuming dims: var_data[time, lat, lon], get first time slice
slice.mld <- st.mld[,,,1]

# Close nc
nc_close(nc.mld)

# Convert slice to Albers Equal Area projection
slice.mld.aea.tr <-  slice.mld %>% 
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom)

# Create a polygon layer to test intersections
slice.mld.aea.tr.poly <-  slice.mld.aea.tr %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_union()

# Find intersections (which transects are inside slice.aea.tr)
overlap.mld <- st_intersects(survey.transects.sf, slice.mld.aea.tr.poly, 
                             sparse = FALSE)

# Get the indices of transects that intersect
overlapping.mld_transects <- survey.transects.sf[apply(overlap.mld, 
                                                       1, any), ]

# Get the indices of transects that do not intersect
non_overlapping.mld_transects <- survey.transects.sf[!apply(overlap.mld, 
                                                            1, any), ]

# Create file name from device memory
png("mld.regridded_plot_2-step.png", width = 1200, height = 1000, res = 150)

# Check and plot
plot(slice.mld.aea.tr, col = viridis(100), # Number of colour levels
     main = 
       "Mixing Layer Depth (method: CDO Bilinear (2-step trans.)) - Jan.2020",
     axes = TRUE)

# Add zone def polygons with semi-transparent fills and black borders
plot(z1bbp.aea.tr, col = NA, border = "black", add = TRUE)
plot(z2bbp.aea.tr, col = NA, border = "black", add = TRUE)
plot(z3bbp.aea.tr, col = NA, border = "black", add = TRUE)
plot(z4bbp.aea.tr, col = NA, border = "black", add = TRUE)
plot(z5bbp.aea.tr, col = NA, border = "black", add = TRUE)

# Add Pacific coast and state boundaries
plot(st_geometry(PacificCoast.wgs84 %>% 
                   st_transform(.,crs = st_crs(slice.mld.aea.tr))),  
     col = "#E1C699", border = "#ae8f60", lwd = 0.7, add = TRUE)
plot(st_geometry(PCoastStates %>% 
                   st_transform(.,crs = st_crs(slice.mld.aea.tr))),
     col = "#E1C699", border = "#ae8f60", lwd = 0.7, add = TRUE)

# Add city names
coords <- sf::st_coordinates(Populated10)
text(coords[,1], coords[,2], labels = Populated10$name,
     col = "black", pos = 3, cex = 0.8)

# Plot populated places as transects
plot(Populated10, col = "black", pch = 20, cex = 1, add = TRUE)

# Add overlapping and non-overlapping transects
plot(overlapping.mld_transects, pch = 19, col = "black", cex = 0.5, 
     add = TRUE)
plot(non_overlapping.mld_transects, pch = 19, col = "red", cex = 0.5, 
     add = TRUE)

dev.off()

```

## CDO regridding of bathymetry test (2-step)


# CDO regridding of MLD test (1-step)

```{r, test.mld.def}

# 1. Turn on s2 processing for map graphic only
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

# File path
nc_file.mld2 <- here(dir, "Data", "ROMS2", "Regridded", "10x10km",
                     "allvars_mld_hindcast_2020_mld_masked_regrid.nc")

# Open the NetCDF file
nc.mld2 <- nc_open(nc_file.mld2)

# Get all variable names
var_names2 <- names(nc.mld2$var)
var_names2
# [1] "mld"

# Note that we forced the values in the workaround so it is actually not a 
## curvilinear grid any more
st.mld2 <- read_stars(nc_file.mld2, curvilinear = NULL)

# Manually reset the dimensions to the meter-based values stars often 
## struggles with curvilinear-to-rectilinear conversion on read-in
st.mld2 <- st_set_crs(st.mld2, aea_custom)

# Check if meta data is conserved
attributes(st.mld2)$units

# Often meta data will not be conserved and you will need to manually assign it
attr(st.mld2[[1]], "units") <- nc.mld2$var$mld$units

# Check that it is saved
attr(st.mld2[[1]], "units")

# Assuming dims: var_data[time, lat, lon], get first time slice
slice.mld2 <- st.mld2[,,,1]

# Close nc
nc_close(nc.mld2)

# Create a polygon layer to test intersections
slice.mld.aea.poly2 <-  slice.mld2 %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_union()

# Find intersections (which transects are inside slice.aea.tr)
overlap.mld2 <- st_intersects(survey.transects.sf, slice.mld.aea.poly2, 
                              sparse = FALSE)
```

## Find mld intersections

This creates replicate rows for each intersect based on the number of cells intersected in the ROMS output. 

```{r, test.mld.joins}

extract_roms_by_month <- function(f, year_subset) {
  # 1. Load Raster
  r <- terra::rast(f)
  
  # 2. Sync names based on internal time metadata
  r_times <- terra::time(r)
  if(!all(is.na(r_times))) {
    names(r) <- as.character(as.numeric(format(r_times, "%m")))
  } else {
    names(r) <- as.character(1:12) 
  }
  
  # 3. Extract Values
  # Using terra::vect on the year_subset
  v_transects <- terra::vect(year_subset)
  
  # 4. Extract with cells=TRUE to track which grid cell was hit
  # xy=TRUE gives us the center coordinates of the ROMS cell
  ext_raw <- terra::extract(r, v_transects, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, 
                            touches = TRUE) 
  
  # 5. Handle the Join safely
  # Instead of row_number(), we rely on the ID column terra::extract creates
  # which corresponds to the row index of v_transects
  year_subset_with_id <- year_subset %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(temp_ID = seq_len(n()))
  
  # 6. Calculate Diagnostics (Cells per Transect)
  # This counts how many ROMS cells each individual line touched
  diag_counts <- ext_raw %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    summarise(n_cells_intersected = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 7. Merge and Extract
  final_output <- ext_raw %>%
    left_join(year_subset_with_id, by = c("ID" = "temp_ID")) %>%
    left_join(diag_counts, by = "ID") %>%
    # Filter out cases where the point fell outside the raster extent entirely
    filter(!is.na(cell))
  
  # 4. Extract specific month value using matrix indexing
  # We use the Month column from your survey data to pick the right ROMS column
  final_output <- final_output %>%
    mutate(
      roms_value = sapply(1:n(), function(i) {
        month_key <- as.character(Month[i])
        if (month_key %in% names(r)) {
          return(.[i, month_key])
        } else {
          return(NA)
        }
      })
    )
  
  # 5. Cleanup and Date Shielding
  final_output <- final_output %>%
    # Remove the 12 month columns to keep it tidy
    select(-matches("^[0-9]+$")) %>% 
    mutate(
      source_file = basename(f),
      method = "Intersection"
    ) %>%
    # Apply the same date-shielding fix as before
    mutate(across(where(~inherits(.x, "POSIXct") || inherits(.x, "IDate") ||
                          inherits(.x, "Date")), as.character))
  
  return(final_output)
}

# --- EXECUTION ---

# Run the parallel process
plan(multisession, workers = 6) # Keep workers low to avoid RAM crash

all_results <- future_lapply(fls, function(f) {
  # Match year from file name
  file_year <- as.numeric(regmatches(f, regexpr("[0-9]{4}", f)))
  
  # TO DO! Upate with the survey transects you wish to use
  year_subset <- survey.transects.sf %>% 
    filter(as.numeric(as.character(Year)) == file_year)
  
  if(nrow(year_subset) > 0) {
    return(try(extract_roms_by_month(f, year_subset)))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}, future.seed = TRUE)

# Filter and Bind
clean_results <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && !inherits(x, "try-error"),
                        all_results)
mld.final_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(clean_results)

# Restore POSIXct Dates
# Replace 'DateColumn' with the actual name in your data
mld.final_table <- mld.final_table %>%
  mutate(across(matches("Date|Time"), ~as.POSIXct(.x, tz = "UTC")))

mld.final_table

# Save output
fwrite(mld.final_table, here(dir, "Data", "survey.transects.w.mld.obs.csv"), 
                             sep = ";")

length(unique(mld.final_table$keys))
# [1] 3229

```

## For transects without an associated MLD

### Check if bathymetry can be used

Here we use bathymetry instead. Since we do not have time steps in the bathymetric layer, the process is simplified.

```{r, test.bathy.joins}

bathy <- here(dir, "Data", "ROMS2", "Regridded", "10x10km",
              "bathy_nep_h_masked_regrid.nc")

sf_use_s2(TRUE)

# load bathy raster data set
b <- terra::rast(bathy)
 
b_v_transects <- terra::vect(transects.to.run.on.bathymetry)
  
# 1. Extract raw cell values
# Each row represents one intersection between a transect and a cell
bathy.ext_raw <- terra::extract(b, b_v_transects, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, 
                                touches = TRUE) 
  
# 2. Calculate intersection count per Transect ID
# This tells us how many cells each transect (ID) passed through
bathy.intersection_counts <- bathy.ext_raw %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(n_cells_intersected = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Join metadata and counts
bathy.survey_metadata <- transects.to.run.on.bathymetry %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(bathy.intersection_counts, by = "ID")
  
# 4. Combine everything
bathy.final_output <- bathy.ext_raw %>%
  left_join(bathy.survey_metadata, by = "ID")

# View(bathy.final_output)

# Save output
fwrite(bathy.final_output, here(dir, "Data",
                                "survey.transects.w.bathy.obs.csv"),
       sep = ";")
```

#### Load function and execute

```{r, nn.approach}

# Make sure s2 is on
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

extract_roms_by_month2 <- function(f, year_subset) {
  # 1. Load Raster
  r <- terra::rast(f)

  # 2. Sync Raster Layer Names with internal POSIXct time
  # terra::time(r) returns the POSIXct vector
  r_times <- terra::time(r)
  
  # 2. Sync Raster Layer Names with internal POSIXct time
  # This ensures that names(r) accurately reflects the months in the file
  if(!all(is.na(r_times))) {
    # Extract month (1-12) from the POSIXct metadata
    names(r) <- as.character(as.numeric(format(terra::time(r), "%m")))
  } else {
    names(r) <- as.character(1:12) 
  }
  
  # 3. Handle Annual NA changes
  # Convert to points, dropping cells that are NA for THIS specific year/file
  r_pts <- terra::as.points(r, values = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  r_pts_sf <- st_as_sf(r_pts)
  
  # 4. Nearest Neighbor Search
  # This finds the closest point that HAS data for the current year
  nn_indices <- unlist(nngeo::st_nn(year_subset, r_pts_sf, k = 1, 
                                    progress = FALSE))
  nn_values <- r_pts_sf[nn_indices, ] %>% st_drop_geometry()

  # 5. Extraction & Date Protection
  result <- year_subset %>%
    mutate(
      roms_value = sapply(1:n(), function(i) {
        month_key <- as.character(Month[i])
        # Safe extraction: check if the month exists in this specific file
        if(month_key %in% names(nn_values)) {
          return(nn_values[i, month_key])
        } else {
          return(NA)
        }
      }),
      source_file = basename(f)
    ) %>%
    # SHIELD DATES: Convert POSIXct/IDate to Character to avoid vec_proxy errors
    mutate(across(where(~inherits(.x, "POSIXct") || inherits(.x, "IDate") || inherits(.x, "Date")), as.character))
  
  return(result)
}

# --- EXECUTION ---

# Run the parallel process
plan(multisession, workers = 6) # Keep workers low to avoid RAM crash

all_results2 <- future_lapply(fls, function(f) {
  # Match year from file name
  file_year <- as.numeric(regmatches(f, regexpr("[0-9]{4}", f)))
  
  year_subset <- transects.to.run.nn %>% 
    filter(as.numeric(as.character(Year)) == file_year)
  
  if(nrow(year_subset) > 0) {
    return(try(extract_roms_by_month2(f, year_subset)))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}, future.seed = TRUE)

# Filter and Bind
clean_results <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && !inherits(x, "try-error"), all_results2)
mld.final_table2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(clean_results)

# Restore POSIXct Dates
# Replace 'DateColumn' with the actual name in your data
mld.final_table_w.nn <- mld.final_table2 %>%
  mutate(across(matches("Date|Time"), ~as.POSIXct(.x, tz = "UTC")))

mld.final_table_w.nn <- mld.final_table_w.nn %>%
  # Remove individual fish observations
  select(-c(source_file, standard_length, Bio_Weight_kg, 
            Scaled_Biomass_Contribution, FID)) %>%
  distinct()
```
